Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 11

“Therefore, all of you, stationed in your respective positions at the entrances of the army divisions, should support Bhishma alone.”

Duryodhana issues his first tactical order — protect Bhishma at all costs. The old grandsire is treated as the linchpin of the entire Kaurava strategy.
